result.summary: The page is mostly functional and visually consistent, with only minor readability and spacing concerns: faded low-contrast text in the search/header area and slightly cramped header spacing with an overlapping notification badge.

issues.description: The search field placeholder text and the location address text appear blurred/washed out with low contrast, making them harder to read.
issues.suggestion: Use a solid, darker neutral color for placeholder and secondary text instead of a faded/blurred appearance.

issues.description: The header area feels cramped: the deliver-to address row and the notification bell sit very close to the top edge, and the bell's notification dot slightly overlaps the icon.
issues.suggestion: Add a bit more vertical padding around the top bar and adjust the badge position so it does not overlap the bell.
